'''Zaria''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Zaria system/Legends|Zaria system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Senex-Juvex Loop]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Anstares system/Legends|Anstares]] and [[Malador system/Legends|Malador systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

An [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]], Zaria was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], [[Frog/Legends|frog]]-like [[Zarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Although the Zarians themselves were free, their homeworld, like the rest of the Senex-Juvex worlds, was under the control of the region's [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zaria was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
